docs_intentionally_untouched.reason: Conversation summaries are historical records — they reflect what was true at the time. The 'upcoming PostgreSQL integration' reference in the analytics hardening lane summary is accurate for its timestamp. Conversation summaries are not policed for staleness.

Per migration policy: old Markdown docs must not be deleted until (1) JSON replacement exists, (2) JSON validates against schema, (3) static renderer renders it, (4) migration manifest maps old_path to new_path, (5) references updated, (6) tests pass, (7) deletion listed in final report. None of these conditions were triggered by this alignment mission. All 46 remaining Markdown files are preserved.

'DuckDB is the only database component' is an accurate statement about the CURRENT state in the current-architecture-inventory section. The audit goes on to propose PostgreSQL migration. Adding a temporal qualifier would be a style edit, not a doctrine correction.

'Zstandard only used for teleport diff compression' is accurate — codebase inspection confirms Zstandard is only imported in rig_relay/core/teleport/teleport.py. The 'underutilized' assessment is correct. No patch needed.

doctrine_decisions_propagated: Parquet is derived analytical snapshot, never canonical event truth
PostgreSQL is enterprise operational substrate, JSON/JSONL/CSV are canonical artifacts
DuckDB is disposable analytical microscope, read-side only
Zstandard is compression optimization — not redaction, not privacy, not canonical authority
Pydantic v2 is typed model boundary — exploit harder before adding serialization deps
Arrow is transient in-memory prototype behind ProjectionStorePort, optional [arrow] extra
pgvector requires sensitive-derived-data policy before implementation
pg_jsonschema is defense-in-depth, not primary validation
psycopg 3 COPY with staging tables and constraint promotion — never bypass validation
Polars/Ibis/DataFusion/orjson/SQLGlot parked until measured bottlenecks justify
No new dependency approved for immediate implementation beyond existing canonical deps
Content-light enforcement must apply at every substrate pipeline stage
Product telemetry opt-out must not disable audit/evidence/operational substrate
